title: 基于超网络的大语言模型知识注入缩放定律
summary: 本文研究了超网络在大语言模型训练时知识注入中的缩放行为。通过解耦超网络注入能力与目标模型通用能力，首次严格分析了超网络深度、宽度和目标网络大小对损失、推理准确率和OOD泛化的影响。构建了MegaWikiQA数据集，实验表明超网络注入在所有架构轴上呈现幂律缩放，且OOD泛化能力随规模提升，是LoRA微调和全微调的有前景替代方案。
summary_en: This paper investigates the scaling behavior of hypernetworks for train-time knowledge injection in LLMs. By decoupling injection capacity from target model capability, it provides the first rigorous study of scaling laws for hypernetwork architectures, showing power-law scaling and improved OOD generalization, positioning hypernetworks as a scalable alternative to LoRA and full fine-tuning.
